title: Anyone actually gotten a phishing site taken down on Vercel? What worked?
description: This report discusses difficulties in getting phishing sites hosted on Vercel's platform taken down despite abuse reports. The phishing site impersonates a legitimate brand to harvest credit card data via fake checkout and 3DS OTP prompts. The reporter seeks community advice on effective takedown strategies, including reporting methods and escalation tactics. No direct technical details or exploit code are provided.
